description.zh:
业务模块
- exception(异常分析)
- lag(卡顿分析)
- custom(自定义异常)
- crash(崩溃分析)
- h5JsError(h5-JS错误)
- h5WhiteScreen(h5-白屏)
description.en:
The business module. Valid values:
- exception: exception analysis
- lag: lag analysis
- custom: custom exception
- crash: crash analysis
- h5JsError: H5 JS error
- h5WhiteScreen: H5 white screen.

description.zh: 强制跳过缓存查询（非必请不要传递强制刷新）
description.en: Specifies whether to forcibly skip the cache query. Do not pass this parameter unless necessary.

descriptions.zh:
应用接入崩溃SDK后并上报响应崩溃，可以通过该接口获取详细的崩溃报告。

在使用该接口之前，请先通过 GetErrors 获取对应的错误详情。
descriptions.en:
After your application integrates the crash SDK and reports crashes, you can call this operation to retrieve detailed crash reports.

Before calling this operation, call GetErrors to retrieve the corresponding error details.
